table.name: TLGNR_SIMPLE_VEHICLE_TYPE_BS
table.description: Types of simple vehicle (ship, block train, ...). The type of a vehicle characterizes its features as far as relevant to Logon.

column.name: SIMPLE_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: volume_m3
column.description: Loading capacity of the vehicle in cubic meters. Used for calculation (order entry, exact customer order) if the order is not yet scheduled on a real vehicle and the base unit of the material is in cubic meters.

column.name: planning_net_weight_t
column.description: Planned/estimated max net weight in tons of the simple vehicle type: used in order entry to initialize the quantity per delivery field and for Uom 'Truck' nominator/denominator determination once the order gets persisted.
